name: node
notes:
The vendored Node runtime — the fifth pack, so a release install needs only git (bun stays the build runtime and is never vendored). The version equals .node-version (prover-pinned: the runtime a release ships is the calibration runtime the build and hosted verification run on). One official nodejs.org archive per platform; every sha256 is taken from that release's SHASUMS256.txt (the checksums url above), never computed locally. The fetch (bun run scripts/vendor/fetch-node.ts) verifies the archive digest BEFORE extraction and installs only the runtime binary (bin/node · node.exe) and Node's LICENSE into vendor/node/extracted// — npm, corepack, headers and man pages are deliberately left out; the host platform by default, --platform

/ --all for other caches. The build vendors the host platform's cache at the fixed path dist/vendor/node, which every launcher resolves after MERCURY_NODE and before a PATH node; the release archive carries it beside mercury.mjs, the manifest records version · platform · archive digest · shipped-binary digest, and install/update smoke the payload on that runtime before activating it. Node's LICENSE file carries the notices of every component it bundles (V8, libuv, OpenSSL, ICU, zlib, c-ares, nghttp2, simdjson and the rest) and ships whole. Update procedure: bump .node-version and this version, rewrite every platform's archive name and url, take each sha256 from the new SHASUMS256.txt, run `bun run scripts/vendor/fetch-node.ts --all`, rebuild, re-run `bash scripts/updater/run-all.sh` and `bash scripts/node-runtime/run-all.sh`.
